'''Lorro''' was the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[King/Legends|king]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]-allied [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aquella]]. He was one of several heads of state summoned by the Imperial [[General/Legends|General]] [[Arkos Rakton]] to a diplomatic summit on [[Outpost 256]], where Rakton seized the heads of state by force. His companion [[Helik]] managed to contact the Republic and Lorro and the others were rescued from Rakton's forces by [[Havoc Squad]]. Afterwards, those that remained loyal to the Republic called for execution of the traitorous [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Kailur]] and [[Premier]] [[Vonn]] who almost accepted Rakton's offer to join the Empire. However Havoc Squad [[Major/Legends|Major]] refused to carry it out.<ref name="TOR" />
